summary: postinstall plants undocumented system-path command via opaque platform sub-packages
details: opencode-engos-ai@1.21.3 is a name-lookalike of the opencode / opencode-ai CLI. Its postinstall script invokes a fresh `npm install` of platform-specific optionalDependencies to obtain a binary and then writes symlinks at /usr/local/bin/innexarcode and /usr/bin/innexarcode (chmod 0755) pointing at that binary. The installed command name `innexarcode` matches neither the package name nor the declared `bin` entry (`opencode-engos` ->./bin/opencode.exe), is not documented (the tarball ships no README or source), and is not discoverable through package.json. The delivered binary is fetched from opaque per-platform sub-packages with no hash or signature verification, and the postinstall runs an additional package-manager install step outside of the normal dependency-resolution flow. The net effect on a default `npm install` is a system-wide command placed on the installer's PATH under a stealth name that executes unverified bytes controlled by whoever publishes the platform sub-packages.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
